response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.rate AS excess FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Groups with a zero or unknown total duration have no calculable rate and are excluded; AVG ignores their NULL rates.
